advancements.rpg_series.spell_cast_rogue: Use a skill from the Rogue Handbook
advancements.rpg_series.spell_cast_warri: Use a skill from the Warrior's Codex
advancements.rpg_series.trade_with_arms_: Trade with an Arms Dealer villager
effect.rogues.last_stand.description: Increases maximum health and reduces damage taken
item.rogues.spell_book/rogue.spell_bindi:
Spell Book of Rogues, using quick weapons and skills to strike enemies from the shadows
- Strengths: High mobility and melee attack damage
- Weaknesses: Mediocre defense and limited ranged attacks
- Equipment: Moderately armored
item.rogues.spell_book/warrior.spell_bin:
Spell Book of Warriors, using heavy weapons and skills to dominate close combat
- Strengths: Strong melee attacks with good mobility
- Weaknesses: Limited ranged attacks and supportive skills
- Equipment: Heavily armored
spell.rogues.bear_trap.description: Set 3 bear traps around you, lasting {cloud_duration} sec. The first enemy to step into a trap springs it shut, taking {damage} damage and being held in place for {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.bear_trap.name: Bear Trap
spell.rogues.charge.description: Increases movement speed and knockback resistance, frees you from movement impairing effects, lasts for {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.charge.name: Charge
spell.rogues.last_stand.description: Stand your ground while channeling. Each stack increases your maximum health and knockback resistance, up to +100%% at {effect_amplifier_cap} stacks. Lasts {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.last_stand.name: Last Stand
spell.rogues.mortal_strike.description: Perform an overhead strike for {weapon_damage_bonus} bonus weapon damage, causing the target to Bleed for {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.mortal_strike.name: Mortal Strike
spell.rogues.mutilate.description: Tear into everything in front of you with both weapons. Strikes with the damage of both held weapons.
spell.rogues.mutilate.name: Mutilate
spell.rogues.shadow_step.description: Step through the shadows to appear behind your target.
spell.rogues.shadow_step.name: Shadowstep
spell.rogues.shock_powder.name: Shock Powder
spell.rogues.shout.description: Shout at nearby enemies, reducing their attack damage by {damage_reduction} for {effect_duration} sec, and dealing a small amount of damage.
spell.rogues.shout.name: Demoralizing Shout
spell.rogues.slice_and_dice.description: Enter a battle trance, during which your attacks will each grant extra power, stacking up to {effect_amplifier_cap} times. Expires after {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.slice_and_dice.name: Slice & Dice
spell.rogues.throw.description: Throw your weapon at the target, dealing {damage} damage and reducing their armor by {armor_reduction} for {effect_duration} sec.
spell.rogues.throw.name: Shattering Throw
spell.rogues.throw_net.description: Hurl a weighted net, dealing {damage} damage and pinning the target in place for {effect_duration} sec. The longer the cast is held, the harder it lands and the further it flies.
spell.rogues.throw_net.name: Throw Net
spell.rogues.vanish.description: Vanish from sight, entering stealth for {effect_duration} sec. Performing any action or taking damage will break the effect.
spell.rogues.vanish.name: Vanish
